entities.name: Menkheperre
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Menkheperre, son of Pinedjem I by wife Duathathor-Henuttawy, was the High Priests of Amun at Thebes in ancient Egypt from 1045 BC to 992 BC and ruler of the south of the country.
